documented_probe: C-2e082c47 (shape-robust kernel across both gate modes) + C-c34cf87e (kernel bodies restricted to triton.language ops with explicit reductions): one task covers both. The agent implements an optionally gated LayerNorm as a @triton.jit kernel under TRITON_INTERPRET=1; hidden probes execute it against a pure-torch reference on a matrix of shapes (B=1, S=1, D=1, odd non-power-of-two D) in both the gated and no-gate branches, at rtol=1e-4/atol=1e-6, and an AST/text inspection fails the task if tl.sum / .sum( / the built-in sum or any torch/numpy/math call appears inside the kernel bodies.
notes: Medium: author a shape-robust Triton kernel in CPU interpreter mode with two reduction passes (mean, variance) expressed without the tl.sum helper, an optional-gate branch, and masked handling of non-power-of-two D. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (reduction without the sum helper; padding/masking), debugging_ambiguity (interpreter-mode semantics differ from GPU Triton), adversarial_inputs (edge shapes and the None-gate branch), hidden_case_generalization (hidden shape/mode matrix), quantitative_correctness (tight float32 tolerance).
